items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: we was, uh, Lori and I was working together.

ctx.x: How did it happen he was playing drums then?

Uh, what happened that, we had a little group at the, uh, Lamp Post on Bourbon and the Sinan, right across from Pete Fountain Place, and, uh, we was, uh, Lori and I was working together. You know you'd like to do the ink spot thing. Mm-hmm. And, uh, so we just had a piano, just me on piano, so we decided to try to fully in a little mode. We couldn't do ink spot numbers all night long. It got monotonous. So I had Lloyd, Lloyd rented an old drum. And so Lloyd started playing drums along with me. And then after…
You know, I never did know that Lloyd was a drummer before that. I don't remember playing that.
